moments.text: Infrared sensor looking down on houses, parked cars and a tree at night; crosshair on a rooftop beside a white-hot car. Black boxes hide overlay text.
A small dark streak enters at the upper-left edge and crosses to the right edge, drifting slightly downward, in about 0.7 s.
The clip jumps back and replays the same scene in slow motion.
Slowed replay: the dark streak crosses again from the left edge to the right edge, passing just above the crosshair.
The clip jumps back again for an even slower replay.
Slowest replay: the dark streak, stretched along its path, takes about 6 s to cross from the left edge to the right edge.
